CFG.REPO_FULL_NAME_HINT: Leave empty to list issues created by you or assigned to you across every repository on this host (scope "All" is not available then). Set this up as a new provider rather than clearing the repository of an existing one: tasks already linked would no longer resolve.

ERRORS.HOST_WIDE_SCOPE: Gitea / Forgejo: without a repository, choose the scope "Created by me" or "Assigned to me".
ERRORS.ID_WITHOUT_REPO: Gitea / Forgejo: issue {{id}} belongs to the repository that was removed from this provider. Restore the repository or re-add the task from a host-wide provider.

FORM_HELP:
Here you can configure Super Productivity to list open issues from a Gitea or Forgejo host (for example Codeberg) in the task creation panel in the daily planning view. Enter a repository as owner/repo, or leave it empty to work across all repositories you can access. Issues will be listed as suggestions and provide a link to the issue as well as more information about it.

In addition, you can automatically add and import all open issues.

To get by usage limits and gain access, you can provide an access token.
